response.sql:
WITH funding_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    AVG((ss.boxy - ss.boxx) / NULLIF(ss.boxx, 0)) AS avg_yvsxdiff,
    AVG(ss.aream2 / NULLIF(ss.volm3, 0)) AS areavolratio
  FROM projects p
  JOIN scanspatial ss ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
cross_source_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(areavolratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM funding_metrics
)
SELECT 
  fm.fundflux,
  fm.avg_yvsxdiff,
  fm.areavolratio,
  fm.areavolratio - csa.overall_avg AS above_average
FROM funding_metrics fm
CROSS JOIN cross_source_avg csa
WHERE fm.areavolratio > csa.overall_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Division by zero: When boxx=0 or volm3=0, NULLIF converts them to NULL, making the division result NULL, which AVG() then ignores. The request does not explicitly specify handling for zero denominators.

alternatives.interpretation: The cross-source average should be calculated from all individual records (weighted by the number of records per funding source), not as an unweighted mean of per-funding-source figures. This interprets 'across all funding sources' as 'considering all data across all funding sources'.
alternatives.sql:
WITH all_records AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    (ss.boxy - ss.boxx) / NULLIF(ss.boxx, 0) AS yvsxdiff,
    ss.aream2 / NULLIF(ss.volm3, 0) AS areavolratio
  FROM projects p
  JOIN scanspatial ss ON p.arcregistry = ss.arcref
),
funding_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    AVG(yvsxdiff) AS avg_yvsxdiff,
    AVG(areavolratio) AS areavolratio
  FROM all_records
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
global_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(areavolratio) AS overall_avg
  FROM all_records
)
SELECT 
  fm.fundflux,
  fm.avg_yvsxdiff,
  fm.areavolratio,
  fm.areavolratio - ga.overall_avg AS above_average
FROM funding_metrics fm
CROSS JOIN global_avg ga
WHERE fm.areavolratio > ga.overall_avg;
